sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Fire Release, Finisher, Chain

system.description:
You release explosive sulfuric smoke from behind you with enough force to crack the ground. This explosive of smoke, propels you towards your enemy in an instant.

Make a melee Ninjutsu or Taijutsu attack. On a hit, you deal 5d12 Fire damage if a Ninjutsu attack or [Unarmed Damage] (or [Weapon Damage]) + 3d12 fire damage if a Taijutsu attack.

On a hit, the creature makes a Dexterity saving throw, being pushed 20 feet away, falling prone and being Blinded until the end of their next turn on a failed save.

Finisher: This attack isn’t a single one, but instead a flurry of sulfuric backed strikes, bleeding into the enemies skin, burning and wounding them. The affected creature that makes their saving throw, must make it at disadvantage. On a failed save, they are Confused for the next minute as the sulfuric smoke makes it difficult for them to even think. Affected creature makes a Constitution saving throw to end the Confused condition.

Chain 3: If your attack is 5 or more than the targets AC, you regain the action or Bonus action used to cast this jutsu.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the damage by 1d12.
